metadata.source: Our World in Data grapher export of the UN World Population Prospects (population-unwpp.csv?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true)
metadata.description: A curated subset of the analysis panel: the full 1950-2023 yearly population series for each selected country.  The notebook rebuilds the artifact's panel columns (log10, mantissa, leading digit, fold tag) from these raw values, so every statistic is computed from the same numbers the full run used.
metadata.example_unit: one entity (country) with its complete yearly population series
metadata.selection_note: 100 countries chosen to span the population range: ten evenly spaced picks from each decile of the median-population distribution, so the digit and size-law machinery sees the full panel's spread.

columns.population: population at that year, as printed by the source
columns.raw_str: the source's own printed string, used for significant-digit counting
columns.is_projection: 1 where the WPP value is a projection (year >= 2024), else 0
columns.tag_sids: 1 if the country is a UN Small Island Developing State
columns.tag_top20: 1 if the country is in the 20 largest by median population
